title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England files with the Department of Public Utilities for review and approval a 365-Day Firm Transportation Service Agreement with Abbey Landmark Operating, L.L.C.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul J. Hibbard, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating and Tim Woolf. (DPU 07-GC-25).
